name: Fence drift
definition: A rip fence that slowly loses registration during a long cut.
notes: Symptom. Cause still hypothesized in SRC-003.

name: Mobile-base walk
definition: A machine on casters that travels under load.

name: One-home filing
definition: Durable facts live in one editable table. Links are allowed. Second editors are not.
notes: Example of a design principle stored as a concept.

name: Heat-cam hypothesis
definition: Fence drift caused by heat plus a loose cam rather than a bent rail.
notes: Do not treat as shop policy.

name: Incident versus policy
definition: An event stays in sources until it earns a rule or a reusable concept.
notes: Promotion requires evidence plus an explicit status change.
